title: Hybrid Visualization of the Medical Images Data Sets

findings.antecedent: Hybrid method visualization (first medical image data set)
findings.consequent: number of false colors in visualization
findings.mechanism: by combining continuity and trustworthy properties to preserve color distances
findings.quote: the Hybrid method has few number of false colors than Isomap and CDA

findings.antecedent: Isomap visualization (first medical image data set)
findings.consequent: number of false colors in visualization
findings.mechanism: due to its focus on continuity preservation which can lead to false neighborhoods
findings.quote: worst visualization is generated by Isomap because the number of false colors is very high.

findings.antecedent: Hybrid method visualization (second medical image data set)
findings.consequent: number of false colors in visualization
findings.mechanism: by combining continuity and trustworthy properties to preserve color distances
findings.quote: the same efficiency is also happened for second data sets in which Hybrid method is better in having less number of false colors

findings.antecedent: Hybrid method visualization (second medical image data set)
findings.mechanism: by combining continuity and trustworthy properties to preserve color distances
findings.quote: Hybrid method is better in having less number of false colors so that it has better trustworthy histogram.

findings.consequent: preservation of distances between visualization and original space
findings.mechanism: by combining continuity and trustworthy properties
findings.quote: the proposed method gets values more close to the original distances.

findings.antecedent: Isomap visualization of neighboring regions p1 and p2 (original distance 0.254)
findings.consequent: color distance between p1 and p2
findings.mechanism: Isomap's inability to preserve local distances accurately
findings.quote: The color distance between p₁ and p2 in Isomap ... are 0.501 ... not preserved with their corresponding distance in the original space which is 0.254.

findings.antecedent: CDA visualization of neighboring regions p1 and p2 (original distance 0.254)
findings.consequent: color distance between p1 and p2
findings.mechanism: CDA's inability to preserve local distances accurately
findings.quote: The color distance between ... CDA visualizations are ... 0.403, respectively, and these values are not preserved with their corresponding distance in the original space which is 0.254.

findings.antecedent: Hybrid visualization of neighboring regions p1 and p2 (original distance 0.254)
findings.consequent: color distance between p1 and p2
findings.mechanism: Hybrid method's ability to preserve neighborhood relations and similarity colors, resulting in a distance closer to the original
findings.quote: p₁ and p2 in Hybrid visualization have the similarity colors where their color distance is 0.106, which is more close to their distances in the original space.

findings.antecedent: Isomap visualization of non-neighboring regions p2 and p3 (original distance 0.576)
findings.consequent: color distance between p2 and p3
findings.mechanism: Isomap's drawback in projecting non-neighbors too close, causing false neighborhoods
findings.quote: The distance value between p2 and p3 in the original space is 0.576, and the colors distance between then in Isomap ... are 0.044

findings.antecedent: CDA visualization of non-neighboring regions p2 and p3 (original distance 0.576)
findings.consequent: color distance between p2 and p3
findings.mechanism: CDA's drawback in projecting non-neighbors too close, causing false neighborhoods
findings.quote: The distance value between p2 and p3 in the original space is 0.576, and the colors distance between then in ... CDA ... are ... 0.163

findings.antecedent: Hybrid visualization of non-neighboring regions p2 and p3 (original distance 0.576)
findings.consequent: color distance between p2 and p3
findings.mechanism: Hybrid method's ability to preserve non-neighborhood relations accurately, resulting in a distance very close to the original
findings.quote: The distance value between p2 and p3 in the original space is 0.576, and the colors distance between then in ... Hybrid visualizations are ... 0.534

findings.consequent: ability to reveal perfect color display and overcome false neighborhood errors
findings.mechanism: by combining continuity and trustworthy properties
findings.quote: the Hybrid method visualization is more preferable for revealing perfect color display overcomes the false neighborhood errors.

stimuli.description: Two medical image datasets: first (146x190x6 dimensions), second (175x160x6 dimensions). The output visualizations are CIELAB color images.

tables.description: Comparison of color distances between selected regions (p1-p2 and p2-p3) in original space and visualizations by Isomap, CDA, and Hybrid methods.
